Blocks.Section: Documented duplicate job error (ErrorCode:2009)
SectionPath: Documented duplicate job error (ErrorCode:2009)

Blocks.Section: Application secret management APIs
SectionPath: Application secret management APIs
Blocks.Text: New Child Application Secret Management APIs - Added support for rotating and deleting secrets for parent, child, and standalone applications. Partners can now maintain up to two active secrets per application, enabling zero-downtime credential updates. See Application Secret Management for implementation details.

Blocks.Section: Job poster email requirement and posting guidelines
SectionPath: Job poster email requirement and posting guidelines
Blocks.Text:
Job Posting guidelines: New guidelines are added to require a valid email address associated with the job posting owner (see the last bullet in point 2.) and restrict access to LinkedIn integration to paying users (see point 7.) in Third-Party Job Listing and Job Site Inclusion Guidelines.
XML feed: The XML feed schema is updated to require inclusion of the job poster email for each job.
Job Posting API: The Unversioned API and Versioned Job Posting API schema are updated to require inclusion of the job poster email for each job.

Blocks.Section: LinkedIn Easy Apply free application limit error code
SectionPath: LinkedIn Easy Apply free application limit error code
Blocks.Text: A new error code 1157 is added to indicate when LinkedIn Easy Apply is disabled due to exceeding the free application limit. To restore LinkedIn Easy Apply, promote the job to a paid slot. To learn more, see LinkedInApplyStatus Error Codes.

Blocks.Section: Versioned API release cycle and schema changes
SectionPath: Versioned API release cycle and schema changes
Blocks.Text:
LinkedIn's Talent APIs are transitioning to a versioned API release cycle starting with the January 2025 release under a new base path: https://api.linkedin.com/rest/, see LTS API Documentation Versioning. As of January version release, only Simple Job Posting API supports versioning. You can leverage latest schema by calling the API with header 202501.
Recruiter Extension Schema is no longer supported in versioned simpleJobPosting API. For RSC partners a new Requisition API will be soon released in April 2025 to manage private jobs aka application tracking system job requisitions for 1-Click Export.

Blocks.Section: Versioned API release cycle and schema changes
SectionPath: Versioned API release cycle and schema changes

Rows.Text: Two more operation types are added to the enum i.e. UPGRADE, DOWNGRADE. UPGRADE: promote a free job to paid; DOWNGRADE: de-promote a paid job to free.
Default expiry date is set to 180 days for all types of jobs. Max expiry date is relaxed to 365 days.

Every job must be either PUBLIC or INTERNAL. We have removed PRIVATE_TO_ATS_INTEGRATION. You can map the requisition to a PUBLIC job using partnerRequisitionId. We are soon launching a requisition API for RSC partner's to provide more flexibility around jobs and requisition mapping.
Company URN of this job, previously referred via integrationContext field. You can use the company lookup API to fetch company details.
This field is deprecated and can be replaced by company,companyName or companyPageUrl

The Unique ID of the job requisition, which links the job posting to ATS requisition. All job posting customers can use this field to map ATS job requisition to LinkedIn jobs. This field is required for RSC customers using RSC integration.

SimpleJobPostingTask Schema

SectionPath: Workplace types and schema deprecation for API
Blocks.Text: A consolidated summary of the changes that the API partner needs to take care of is given below:

Blocks.Section: Job Posting API changes
SectionPath: Workplace types and schema deprecation for API
Job Posting API changes

Rows.Text: postalCode field will be deprecated. We recommend using the location field instead
countryCode field will be deprecated. We recommend using the location field instead
workRemoteAllowed field will be deprecated. We recommend using the workplaceTypes field instead. This field will be available for use by November 15, 2022

state field will be deprecated. We recommend using the jobPostingOperationType field instead. Thus, the state.listed field should be replaced by jobPostingOperationType.create and state.closed field should be replaced by jobPostingOperationType.close field

A value greater than 180 will not be allowed for the expireAt field. ATS should display to customers that the life of the job posting on LinkedIn will be 180 days and reflect the status as CLOSED on LinkedIn after 180 days. Once the job posting is closed on LinkedIn, it will be good to provide customers the support to RENEW the job posting or configure Auto-Renew in which case, ATS/Partner can renew the jobs proactively after 180 days if the job posting is still in LIVE/OPEN state on partner platform
